data.description: From the Result Validator report (Drift, smaller items): CI runs just test but never just bank-audit, so the audit's checks over the real bank reach CI only through pytest's fixtures. Add a CI step that runs just bank-audit on the committed bank and fails the job on a FAIL (a WARN passes, as the recipe does). The report is organizer-only and gitignored; do not upload it as an artifact (AC-25). Touches .github/workflows/** (a serialized shared file: ask before editing). Acceptance: the step runs on a PR and on main, green on main @ the merge of this ticket; a planted fifth record written answer-last in a throwaway branch turns it red (name the mutation). HELD: minted from the audit; released on the client's word.
data.title: Run just bank-audit in CI

data.body: AUDIT from the guardrail audit (PQ-28, PR #49, docs/audit/2026-10-guardrail-audit.md, audit tree 0c7d60a): GAP-23 (G-11, Minor): bank-audit is not its own CI step. This ticket covers it; sufficient.

FINDING PQ-49 (does not block this ticket; outside its scope, nothing changed): GitHub reports mrojas54/rust-nyc-pop-quiz as public, and an anonymous request for bank/questions/q8.json on main returns 200. bank/README.md line 18 says the repository stays private and that a public bank would end the segment. So the question bank, with answers, is readable by attendees. Changing visibility is Michelle's decision. Continuing PQ-49.

DONE PQ-49 PR https://github.com/mrojas54/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/pull/117 HEAD b0264ea84dca4b051208bcc859031f086b584617 BASE 622e0fdf5dcd41c93c742c917915cc8f5c64c475 test cargo 345 passed 4 ignored, pytest 1149 passed 1 skipped, web 303 passed test-warm 30s ci success (just test, just test-full; run 41455911717; step 'Audit the committed bank' success; its log shows only 'bank-audit: passed'; scan of the run log for tell text: no matches) review: Codex PASS, no findings, reviewed b0264ea84dca4b051208bcc859031f086b584617, one pass mutations: answer-last fifth record -> exit 0, 3 WARN, no FAIL (does not turn it red since PQ-45); four-option fifth record -> exit 1, caught by the AC-24 check and records load; 40-char option outside the reserve -> exit 0 with WARN, confirming WARN passes. All in throwaway copies, step script extracted from ci.yml. comments-acted-on: RELEASED dispatch; no other instructions contract-notes: ticket's answer-last plant predates the arrangement, audit left as is; pipeline/README.md and docs/RUNBOOK.md did not need a sentence; harness_config.rs and auth.rs read ci.yml, their pinned facts unchanged deviations: 1) codex review refuses --base with a prompt, so the review ran through codex exec --sandbox read-only over git diff origin/main...HEAD. 2) rebase before push was a no-op, HEAD already on origin/main; git refused it for the placed settings.json, ancestry checked instead. 3) Plant copies were left in the session scratchpad after the rm safety check refused a removal; nothing in the tree changed not-done: red run on the real step, named limit (ruling 6). No test pins the step, ci.yml and two docs were the cleared files. FINDING for Michelle: the repository is public and bank/questions/q8.json reads anonymously (200), against bank/README.md line 18; flag raised, nothing changed. Merging not done.

RULING PQ-49 Michelle 2026-11-02: keep the repository public. The visibility finding is closed; no change made. bank/README.md line 18 still says the repository stays private, which now contradicts her ruling; not edited, outside PQ-49's cleared files. PR #117 is unaffected and still waits on her merge.
